## Night Owl

Based on Sarah Drasner's beloved Night Owl theme for VS Code. Deep navy backgrounds layered with electric blue accents create a calm, focused interface perfect for night-time work.

### Highlights

- **Deep navy palette** — #011627 backgrounds from the original Night Owl spec
- **Electric blue accent (#82AAFF)** — the signature Night Owl highlight color
- **Semantic palette** — green (#addb67), cyan (#7fdbca), red (#EF5350), yellow (#ffcb8b)
- **System fonts** — no custom font download required

### Usage

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/night-owl.css">
```
